text:
Nina: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: leadership asked for a tidy list of GA/beta windows and any hard blockers for API, Console, and Optimize. Opening this thread to collect concrete dates and owners.
Arjun: API update: target GA = early Q3 (we're estimating 4-7 weeks). Current blockers: legal SLA signoff, pricing confirmation, and one gateway concurrency bug Priya is debugging. Owner: Arjun + Platform.
Priya: Gateway bug detail: under heavy streaming + mix of short sync calls we see token-bucket contention causing request stalls. I have a reproducer and a patch in review. If patch passes staging we can validate tomorrow.
Liam: From runtime: need to validate p99 on Dedicated for the GA cohort. Plan is 10% canary -> monitor p99 and resource profiles -> 50% -> 100%. Can start canary after Priya's fix is promoted. Owner: Liam (Eng-runtime).
Nina: Console clarification: leadership wants "GA for core admin and rollout workflows" by mid-Q3. That excludes Optimize UX and external APM linking which can be Q4. Owner: Priya for Console UI scope.
Arjun: Beta features (structured output, tool-calls) are already in limited beta. Those don't block GA, but we want to widen canary coverage pre-GA.
Priya: Small ask: can teams accept deferring the third-party APM link? It saves ~2 sprints of work and keeps Console on the mid-Q3 path.
FinanceBot: Note: pricing guidance required two weeks before GA to finalize billing surface. Finance owner: @Marcus.
Nina: Optimize timeline: public beta targeted late-Q3, GA in Q4. Needs more offline evals and a simple UI to visualize cost impact. Owner: Arjun + Research. Blocker: per-tenant experiment quota change.
Liam: Ops note: we'll publish canary thresholds and rollback criteria before starting ramp. Expect a 72h observation window at each step.
Arjun: Action items: 1) Priya to land gateway fix and post staging results (ASAP). 2) Marcus (Finance) to confirm pricing timeline. 3) Priya to mark APM integration as deferrable if we agree. 4) Liam to schedule Dedicated p99 canary once fix is in. 5) Nina to maintain a single checklist doc with owners and dates.
Nina: I'll create the checklist and tag owners by EOD tomorrow. Please update this thread if dates slip. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync Fri 10:00 PT.
Priya: Patch merged to staging, running tests now. Will post results in the checklist doc when available. :white_check_mark:
